sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美美元金融中枢、私人利益基金会（PIF）与运河船舶登记

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Real Estate Property Management and Rental Screening Cloud

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Panama-United States Trade Promotion Agreement, in force 31 October 2012, includes an investment chapter
Panama-Canada Free Trade Agreement, in force 1 April 2013, includes an investment chapter
European Union-Central America Association Agreement, applicable to Panama in the trade and investment-in-services areas

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 23 de 27 de abril de 2015 (as amended), adopting measures against money laundering, terrorist financing and proliferation financing, together with binding implementing regulations issued by the Unidad de Analisis Financiero (UAF); Ley 70 de 2019 creating the Registro de Beneficiarios Finales and the corresponding annual filing obligations; applicable rules of the Direccion General de Ingresos (DGI) of the Ministry of Economy and Finance for the administration of the UBO register.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified notarial copy of the passport of each proposed shareholder, director, officer and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the country of origin or residence of the individual
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by the designated competent authority of the issuing country; if the issuing country is not a Hague Apostille member, Panamanian consular legalization is required

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of good standing or certificate of corporate existence of each corporate shareholder or parent company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registry or registrar of companies in the country of incorporation of the corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by the competent authority of the country of registration; alternatively consular legalization by the nearest Panamanian consulate for non-Apostille jurisdictions

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized power of attorney appointing the Panamanian resident agent and the attorneys responsible for incorporation proceedings
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public of the place of execution, stating notarial attestation and witness data
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if executed outside Panama, followed by registration of the power of attorney with the Registro Publico de Panama when required

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO attestation and corporate ownership disclosure affidavit executed by the proposed incorporators and all beneficial owners
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Domestic notarial certification; no apostille is required for a Panamanian notarial act, but the document must be protocolized before the notary and filed with the UBO register

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original bank reference letter or banking due diligence letter from a regulated financial institution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Bank or credit institution holding the applicant's account relationship
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization for foreign-issued letters; Spanish notarized translation if the original is not in Spanish

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of principal place of business, physical address or lease/service agreement supporting the commercial substance of the PropTech platform
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Landlord, property manager or licensed virtual-office service provider
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarial authentication of the lease or service agreement; foreign agreements require apostille or consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: AML/CFT compliance questionnaire and PEP status declaration signed by each proposed shareholder, director and beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Panamanian legal advisor or regulated corporate service provider
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarial signature certification before a Panamanian notary; no apostille required for the notarial certification itself

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-onboarding screening of all proposed UBOs, shareholders, directors and authorized signatories against the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List and de-listing lists, the EU consolidated financial sanctions list, the United Kingdom HM Treasury consolidated list, and Panama's domestic sanctions and administrative prohibition lists published by the Unidad de Analisis Financiero. PEP detection is mandatory using a recognized commercial database supplemented by person-led questionnaires, and must cover family members and close associates where applicable. Negative news and adverse-media searches are required. Enhanced due diligence must be performed if the applicant is resident in or funded from a higher-risk jurisdiction, or if the platform collects rent or client escrow funds in volumes that imply financial intermediation. All findings must be documented in an internal compliance file retained for at least five years and reported to the UAF in accordance with Law 23 of 2015 if suspicious activity is identified.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Portal de Servicios en Linea del Registro Publico de Panama (https://www.registropublico.gob.pa)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Spanish is the official legal language. Corporate names must be readable and pronounceable in Latin script; non-Latin script names must be transliterated into a Spanish phonetic form, which becomes the controlling registered wording. The suffix 'Sociedad Anonima' or 'S.A.' is mandatory for the standard Panama stock corporation. Names must be distinctive, must not be identical or deceptively similar to an existing registered name, and should include the object or activity identifier when necessary to support the ISIC 6201 / real estate technology scope.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: In case of rejection, the applicant or the licensed registered agent may file a written reconsideration petition (recurso de reconsideracion) with the Director General of the Registro Publico de Panama within five business days of notification. The petition must set out the grounds of objection, evidence of prior authorization for any sensitive token, and a comparison of existing registered names. If reconsideration is denied, a hierarchical administrative appeal (recurso de apelacion) may be filed before the higher administrative authority competent under Law 38 of 2000. The appeal must be accompanied by the original rejection certificate, the name reservation application, legal arguments, and any ministerial or non-banking superintendency clearance obtained. A final adverse administrative decision may be challenged before the contentious-administrative jurisdiction of the Supreme Court of Justice. During the appeal, counsel should file a new reservation for at least one fallback alternative name to preserve time.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for this low-risk PropTech and SaaS line of business. The company must maintain a physical registered-agent address in Panama for service of process and all official communications. A licensed virtual office may be used for administrative mail and data-address purposes, provided it does not replace the registered agent's statutory service address and is not a P.O. box.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low. For a standard low-risk ISIC 6201 real estate technology platform with no client-fund custody, the estimated probability of an unannounced on-site inspection in the first 12 months is below 5%. If the platform processes monthly rent collection, property management escrow, or payments on behalf of landlords that create a de facto financial activity, the likelihood increases to 20-30% and the entity should expect supervisory inquiries from the UAF and, potentially, the banking regulator.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registro Publico de Panama - Directorate General

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Public deed of incorporation (escritura constitutiva) before a Panamanian notary public
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Panamanian Notary Public with protocol registry
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notarial tariff applicable to corporate charters

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registration of the Sociedad Anonima with the Registro Publico de Panama and issuance of the certificate of incorporation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registro Publico de Panama - Sociedades Anonimas Section

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: First annual filing in the Registro de Beneficiarios Finales under Ley 70 de 2019
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Direccion General de Ingresos, Ministry of Economy and Finance
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Regulatory fee imposed by the UBO register law

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed Panamanian resident agent services for the first year
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Panama law firm or corporate service provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark of USD 500 - USD 1,200 per annum

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Virtual office and registered-address support services for the first year
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed commercial virtual-office provider in Panama
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for virtual office and registered-mail handling

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization, apostille and consular legalization of foreign identity, corporate and banking due-diligence documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent authorities in the foreign issuing countries, Panamanian consulates, and Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Panama

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Sworn Spanish translation of non-Spanish corporate and banking records
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Certified public translator and Panamanian notary
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark per standard translated document

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT pre-clearance database searches and PEP/sanctions screening of proposed UBOs
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External corporate counsel or compliance provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark flat compliance fee for OFAC, UN, EU, UK and Panama domestic list screening

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation legal due-diligence opinion, corporate structure memo and first-year corporate file opening
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark flat professional fee for pre-incorporation due diligence, UBO piercing and corporate compliance file

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Panama Law 32 of 1927 (Sociedades Anónimas), as amended, including provisions on corporate formation, capital, shares, directors, and registered agents; supplemented by Public Registry regulations and the beneficial ownership registry regime.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — General Directorate of Legal Persons, Mercantile Section
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución (notarial deed of incorporation) together with the Articles of Incorporation (Estatutos Sociales)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-in capital; authorized capital is set in the Articles of Incorporation, commonly US$10,000 divided into shares. No escrow deposit is required for the initial subscribers.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Corporation adopts the registered agent's office in the Republic of Panama as its registered statutory office; the issuance of shares to the initial subscribers as reflected in the share register is ratified; the subscribers and appointees are designated as President, Secretary and Treasurer, with full powers granted by law and the Articles of Incorporation; the officers are authorized to open and operate bank accounts, sign contracts, and execute all tax, municipal, labor and regulatory filings; any one director may instruct registered counsel and take all acts necessary to carry out the corporate purposes; and all pre-incorporation acts are ratified in their entirety.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Availability Search and Corporate Structuring
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Names and Certificates Section
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit two or three proposed corporate names to the Public Registry's name search service. Review the proposed corporate structure, registered agent, share capital, shareholders, and initial directors. Reserve the approved name for the statutory period.
required_dossiers: Completed name search application with three alternative names
Sworn due-diligence statement disclosing beneficial owners and subscribers
Authorized capital and share-class specification
Identification documents of initial shareholders and directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected as confusingly similar, file a reconsideration request with the Public Registry or select the next available alternative name from the submitted list.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation, Execution and Notarization of the Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Panamanian Notary Public and licensed registered agent or corporate counsel
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered attorney drafts the Escritura Pública de Constitución and the Articles of Incorporation. The founders execute the deed before a Panamanian notary, and the registered agent signs the acceptance of the appointment to act as resident agent.
required_dossiers: Approved name certificate
Draft Articles of Incorporation and Bylaws
Registered agent acceptance letter
Identity certificates and passport copies of shareholders and directors
Power of attorney to the incorporating attorney, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary raises a deficiency, execute a corrective addendum or re-execute the deed with corrected schedules before proceeding to registry filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registry Filing and Public Inscription of the Company
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Legal Persons Section
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the notarized Escritura Pública de Constitución with the Public Registry, pay the official stamp and inscription fees, and obtain the certificate of incorporation and the corporate folio number. Legal personality is effective upon inscription.
required_dossiers: Notarized original of the Escritura Pública de Constitución
Power of attorney granted to the registered attorney, if applicable
Name reservation certificate
Payment receipts for registry and fiscal stamp fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registrar issues an objection, file a response through the registered attorney addressing the specific omission; a corrected and re-presented document may be required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Taxpayer Registration and Tax Identification Number (RUC)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministry of Economy and Finance — Sede Electrónica
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the online RUC registration for the Sociedad Anónima, declare the corporate tax domicile, register the statutory agents, and obtain the taxpayer identification number and digital certificate for electronic tax filing.
required_dossiers: Certificate of incorporation and Public Registry inscription
RUC registration form
Proof of registered office address and lease, if any
Resolution appointing the legal representative
Apostilled identification documents of foreign beneficial owners, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DGI queries the application, correct discrepancies in the registered office or corporate data and resubmit through the Sede Electrónica; an in-person review appointment may be required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Commercial License and Zoning Approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipality of Panama (Alcaldía de Panamá) — Treasury and Commerce Departments
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for the Aviso de Operación or municipal commercial operating permit for the PropTech SaaS office; present the zoning certificate if required, declare the ISIC 6201 activity, and pay the applicable municipal tax or fixed fee.
required_dossiers: RUC certificate
Public Registry corporate documents
Lease agreement or property ownership title
Fire-safety inspection report
Certificado de Uso de Suelo (zoning certificate), if applicable
Activity description and ISIC 6201 business declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipality requires supplementary documentation, submit the corrected zoning certificate or updated lease and re-file; administrative reconsideration may be requested before the municipal authority.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Governance Records, Initial Board Meeting and Officer Filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered agent, Panamanian counsel, and Public Registry for protocolization of officer appointments, if required
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board of directors, adopt the pro-forma first board resolution, open the corporate minute book and share ledger, issue share certificates, elect officers, and maintain the registered office and agent records in accordance with the company's bylaws and Law 32 of 1927.
required_dossiers: Minutes of the first board resolution
Share certificate book
Shareholders register and share ledger
Directors' and officers' acceptance letters
Registered agent and registered office appointment records
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Public Registry refuses to record officer changes, execute a supplementary notarial clarification and re-present the corporate folio for inscription.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Comercio e Industrias (MICI) — for ISIC 6201 no industrial manufacturing permit applies; the municipal commercial license governs the physical office premise.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Aviso de Operación Commercial / Permiso de Operación de Actividad Comercial (Municipal Operating Notice)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category I — Registro Ambiental (environmental registration); no full EIA/Estudio de Impacto Ambiental (Category III) is required for a cloud-hosted PropTech SaaS office with no industrial discharges.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process wastewater or industrial air emissions; sanitary office wastewater must comply with municipal discharge standards; electronic waste handling and disposal must follow Panama's hazardous waste and e-waste regulations, including Basel Convention requirements where applicable.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá; structural load inspection for leased office improvements by a certificated engineer; workplace health and safety compliance under MITRADEL Resolution No. 039/2019 on occupational health and safety programs.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of the Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas, Panama — official portal: https://dgi.mef.gob.pa / https://sife.dgi.gob.pa
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities must obtain a Registro Único de Contribuyente (RUC) before engaging in any Panamanian-source taxable activity. Procedure: (1) appoint a local registered agent/legal representative; (2) execute public deed or power of attorney and register with the Public Registry (if required); (3) file RUC application through DGI’s online portal (Sistema de Registro Único) with passport copy, evidence of address, and agent authorization; (4) receive RUC certification and activate Digital Signature/Firma Criptográfica; (5) register for ITBMS/electronic invoicing regime in the same process. No minimum capital or physical presence is required for a non-resident S.A. owner.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid mismatch elections exist under Panamanian law. Tax residence and source rules are statutory. Optional regimes include the Multinational Company Headquarters (SEM) election and the Panama-Pacifico Special Economic Zone regime, but a standard PropTech SaaS S.A. is taxed under the ordinary territorial rules, with limited ability to elect simplified ITBMS accounting for small taxpayers.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios (ITBMS), a transaction-based VAT
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: USD — No monetary threshold: any person (including non-resident S.A.) transferring taxable goods or services in Panama must register for ITBMS. Small taxpayers may use a simplified ITBMS regime if annual taxable turnover does not exceed USD 300,000.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing (Facturación Electrónica) via DGI-approved providers or proprietary systems (SIFE). Invoices must transmit in near-real time to DGI for validation, include a QR code and digital signature, and use DGI-issued technical documentation. Non-compliance suspends invoice authorization and triggers fines.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Export of goods and services is subject to 0% ITBMS. For SaaS/PropTech services, zero-rating applies when the recipient is situated outside Panama, the service’s economic use or benefit occurs abroad, or the delivery through cloud infrastructure is not deemed locally used. The contract must contain a clear Panamanian export declaration and the billing must exclude local ITBMS.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DUA) or Digital Export Certificate for goods; for SaaS services, a service export certificate or sworn affidavit
Commercial invoice issued under DGI electronic invoicing standards showing 0% ITBMS
Contract executed with offshore client, specifying delivery outside Panama
Bank credit advice or SWIFT/ACH proof of foreign remittance
Proof of overseas recipient’s foreign tax residence (e.g., VAT registration certificate, Certificate of Incorporation)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DGI audits zero-rating claims closely; failure to substantiate export status triggers immediate clawback of 7% ITBMS plus legal interest and late-payment surcharges. Fraudulent or simulated exports may subject the S.A. to penalties of up to 200% of the tax, withdrawal of invoice authorization, and criminal prosecution under Panamanian fiscal-criminal law (up to 5 years’ imprisonment). Panama has no foreign-exchange controls; the 180-day period is an audit confirmation benchmark rather than a statutory remittance deadline.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: No central bank exists. The Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP) is the banking regulator, while the Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UAF) enforces AML/CFT obligations. FX policy is effectively determined by free-market mechanics because the US dollar circulates as legal tender.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The US dollar (and its nominal Panamanian counterpart, the Balboa) is fully convertible for both current and capital account items. Profit remittance, foreign capital injection, and liquidation proceeds are freely transferable without prior Exchange Administration approval. No exchange-rate controls, counterparty monopolies, or convertibility taxes apply to a Panamanian Sociedad Anónima.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No surrender rules or mandatory conversion timelines exist. Export receipts may be retained in US dollars or any foreign currency in local or offshore accounts without surrender to a national monetary authority. The Balboa is a nominal unit accounting only for fractional legal-tender coinage.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium. Panama has no standalone e-money institution (EMI) license. Offshore digital EMIs cannot take deposits or issue payment products unless they partner with a Panamanian licensed bank or obtain a fintech/e-money authorization under the SBP's Regional Financial Services Hub framework. Practical integration via Stripe Billing and ACH Direct is feasible on a collected-funds basis using a Panamanian bank account as the settlement node, but the fintech itself must adhere to local contract and AML pass-through obligations.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is not statutorily required for every account, but nearly all SBP-regulated banks demand either (i) an in-person walk-in for final compliance sign-off, (ii) a notarized signature executed in Panama, or (iii) a live video interview with a compliance officer, combined with certified true copies of corporate documents. Remote onboarding is accepted by private banks only when the UBO completes enhanced due diligence and legalizes the signature via a Panamanian notary or a Panama foreign consulate.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sociedad Anónima owned by a non-resident UBO with no demonstrable nexus to Panama
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Good Standing from the Public Registry, notarized corporate bylaws, beneficial-ownership declaration signed by the resident agent, board resolution appointing officers, and a Panamanian commercial lease or local representative agreement proving substance.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UDiscordance between projected payment-gateway revenue and local operating cost footprint
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: SaaS subscription analytics and recurring-revenue report, sample customer contracts, Stripe payout and chargeback statements, cloud-infrastructure invoices, payroll records via an SBP-approved payroll processor, and a certified public accountant's bridge letter.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Discrepancies in beneficial-ownership filed with the resident agent vs Public Registry share registry
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Updated share register ledger, notarized UBO declaration Form SA/UF, current resident agent issuance confirming the final UBO, and a sworn statement with apostilled passport copies of all natural-person shareholders.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unusual inbound transfers from high-risk payment processors or shell FX counterparties
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bank statement segmentation by payment processor, underlying SaaS customer KYC summaries, source-of-funds evidence from contracted PropTech landlords, and a transaction-level audit trail prepared by an independent Panamanian CPA.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All inbound wires must identify the corporate name and cédula jurídica. Use SWIFT MT103 with clear purpose code 'Capital Contribution' or 'Shareholder Loan' and attach the source-of-funds package: notarized share-capital clause, board resolution authorizing the injection, UBO source-of-wealth questionnaire, and a Panamanian tax-exemption declaration (territorial income memo) proving no taxable nexus on capital raises. For non-USD inbound, the bank converts at market rate only after completing a 'Declaración de Origen de Fondos' verification.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound USD clearing executes via SWIFT MT103 for international settlement and via US correspondent networks (Fedwire/CHIPS) for crossing to US payments rails. Domestic and regional payments may continue through ACH Direct for US collections; high-value or documentary trade payments utilize irrevocable commercial letters of credit (MT700) with cover payments through MT103, ensuring clean payment-vs-document matching. Vendor and landlord disbursements within Panama use ACH-Local or interbank transfers governed by the SBP clearing rules.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX spot transactions with SBP-licensed banks using USD as the base legal-tender leg
Outright forwards on EUR/GBP/COP receivables from non-Panama SaaS clients for up to 12 months
Cross-currency swaps between USD and EUR/GBP for foreign operating-cost hedging
Structural natural hedges via matching USD-denominated supplier contracts; non-deliverable forwards are generally unnecessary and only available under narrow approval from the counterparty bank

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Franchise Tax (Tasa Única Anual) for Panamanian Sociedad Anónima
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before 15 July; if the due date is a non-business day, the deadline is the next business day.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment incurs a statutory surcharge plus monthly interest and prevents the issuance of a 'Paz y Salvo'; failure to pay for three consecutive years triggers administrative strike-off by the Registro Público and loss of corporate standing in Panama.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Income Tax Return (Declaración Jurada de Renta) or non-activity declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 March following the fiscal year end (calendar-year basis).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file may produce late-filing fines, monthly interest charges, and a surcharge on the tax assessed for inaccurate returns; continuous non-compliance can trigger sanctions under the Código Fiscal and administrative dissolution.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Municipal Business License Renewal (Aviso de Operación) - applicable only if the S.A. maintains an operational office or taxable establishment in a Panamanian municipality
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Municipal Treasury (Tesorería Municipal) of the relevant Panamanian district
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually, generally on or before 31 January or as provided by the corresponding municipal ordinance.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-renewal suspends the municipal license, exposes the entity to municipal fines and interest, and prevents issuance of municipal 'Paz y Salvo' certificates.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Ownership Registry update/confirmation (Registro de Beneficiarios Finales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) - National Beneficial Ownership Registry under Law 254 of 2021
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 calendar days of any share transfer or change in ultimate beneficial ownership; confirmation with the registered agent during the annual franchise-tax cycle (April to 15 July).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Violations carry monetary penalties under Law 254, restrictions on obtaining corporate certificates, ineligibility for registration acts, and administrative strike-off after repeated non-compliance.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No general statutory audit is imposed on a private, non-listed Panamanian S.A. providing PropTech/real-estate SaaS services. An independent certified audit is mandatory for companies registered with the Superintendencia del Mercado de Valores, regulated financial/fiduciary institutions, and where a court, tax authority, or investor agreement expressly requires audited financial statements. Voluntary audit is common above USD 1,000,000 in annual revenue.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Panama requires the application of IFRS (NIIF) for public-interest entities; private S.A.'s may apply the IFRS for SMEs (NIIF para PYMES) for statutory and tax accounting. There is no separate local GAAP distinct from IFRS.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Panama does not maintain a public shareholders' registry; share transfers are recorded in the internal Register of Members and, when required, reported to the DGI beneficial-ownership registry within 30 days. The registered agent must carry out an annual reconciliation of shareholding, director changes, and UBO data during the franchise-tax cycle (by 15 July), so that the confidential DGI UBO file is current before the franchise tax is paid.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 350 - USD 750 per year (resident agent fee, registered office, secretarial maintenance and statutory register audit)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 0 - USD 5,000 (voluntary or lender-required certified audit of a moderate-size PropTech S.A.; no statutory audit fee when audit is not applicable)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Territorial system: only Panama-source income is taxed; foreign-source income is exempt. No general PropTech tax holiday; an optional SEM (Multinational Headquarters) regime may exempt qualifying foreign-source and certain local services. Accelerated depreciation and investment tax credits may apply to qualifying productivity-enhancing capital expenditures.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 202 (Declaración Jurada de Renta / Annual Income Tax Return) filed through the DGI Sede Electrónica portal at https://sede.dgi.gob.pa; Transfer Pricing Informative Return Form 630 filed separately when thresholds are met.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within three months after the close of the fiscal year; calendar-year filers must file by 31 March.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: RUC identification, business name, fiscal address, resident agent details
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the Panama RUC and maintain active registration; a foreign-owned S.A. without Panama-source activity must still obtain a RUC through a resident agent and file a nil or exempt return.
Insert the exact fiscal year-end; if the S.A. has an approved different fiscal year, use that period consistently.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross Panama-source revenue from all business, services, royalties, rentals, and digital-platform activities
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report revenue from SaaS subscriptions and property-rental screening where the payer, user, or income-generating activity is in Panama. Book foreign-source revenue separately and exclude it from Box 3.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Allowable deductions directly related to Panama-source revenue (costs, operating expenses, depreciation, NOL carryforward)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include only expenses with documentary support and a direct nexus to Panama-source income; allocate shared service costs on a reasonable basis.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable income after NOL carryforward and prior-year losses
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Calculate as Box 3 minus Box 4, limited by the 5-year NOL carryforward rule.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Corporate income tax due at 25%, plus any complementary dividend tax applicable to undistributed profits
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a non-resident-owned S.A., confirm whether the dividend complement has been paid and disclosed to avoid later withholdings.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts a fixed fine of up to PAB 1,000 plus monthly default interest of 1% on unpaid tax. Non-filing after administrative demand may trigger fines of up to PAB 10,000; false or fraudulent returns are subject to surcharges up to 50% of the corrected tax and criminal penalties.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% withholding on dividends paid from Panama-source profits (final tax). Dividends paid from foreign-source profits are outside Panama's territorial tax and are not subject to withholding.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Panama's DTA network is limited (e.g., Barbados, Mexico). To claim a reduced rate, the non-resident beneficial owner must obtain a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from the treaty jurisdiction, submit the TRC and a beneficial-ownership declaration (Form 205 or equivalent) to the Panamanian withholding agent before distribution, and the agent must retain certified copies for at least five years. Absent a DTA or TRC, the statutory 10% rate applies.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties and interest paid to non-residents from Panama-source income are subject to a statutory 12.5% withholding when not reduced by an applicable DTA. Treaty reductions require prior TRC submission to DGI.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: PAB 3,000,000 (USD 3,000,000) in gross revenue in the prior tax year triggers the mandatory Transfer Pricing Informative Return (Form 630). Related-party controlled transactions exceeding PAB 500,000 in aggregate require a local file; group-wide documentation and CbCR apply when consolidated revenue is at least USD 750,000,000.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Panama ESR (Law 254 of 2020 and implementing regulations) applies only to relevant activities: holding of IP, distribution and service centres, financing, insurance, shipping, and headquarters operations. A PropTech SaaS company earning royalties from rental-screening IP will be treated as performing IP holding and must show adequate physical offices, resident employees, and board control in Panama. Standard operational SaaS activity with local substance is not automatically subject to full ESR, but all entities must maintain a bona fide commercial purpose.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Understating Panama-source rental-screening and SaaS revenue, or mischaracterizing Panama-source income as foreign-source to exploit the territorial tax system.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative surcharge of up to 50% of corrected tax, monthly interest on omitted tax, and monetary penalties of up to twice the tax evaded under Panama Tax Code provisions on tax fraud.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: A director who signs a false return can be held personally liable for civil restitution and may face imprisonment of 2 to 5 years, asset freezes, and a travel ban pending criminal proceedings.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a Panamanian S.A. with no physical office, no local staff, no bank account, and no verifiable commercial activity while claiming full foreign-source exemption or treaty benefits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DGI may disregard the corporate entity under Panama's anti-abuse rules, recharacterize income as Panama-source, impose 25% corporate tax plus 10% dividend withholding, and apply ESR fines of up to USD 100,000 if a relevant activity exists.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the resident agent may face cancellation of the corporate registration, joint and several personal assessment for unpaid tax, and travel restrictions where the arrangement constitutes money laundering or fraudulent insolvency.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting ACH or Stripe payment traffic without performing know-your-customer and beneficial-ownership due diligence, or failing to maintain transaction records for the PropTech platform.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines per violation range from USD 10,001 to USD 1,000,000; repeated or aggravated non-compliance can lead to revocation of local business authorization and closure of the Panamanian payment gateway.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Officers, directors, and AML compliance officers who knowingly fail to report suspicious transactions are subject to imprisonment of 5 to 12 years, personal fines, and forfeiture of property derived from the unlawful conduct.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Unauthorized Profit Distribution / Unpaid Dividend WHT
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Declaring and paying dividends out of Panama-source profits without withholding the statutory 10% dividend tax, or reducing stated capital to circumvent the withholding.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DGI compels collection of the unpaid withholding as principal, plus a 10% surcharge and monthly default interest, and the corporation may be fined up to PAB 50,000.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who authorized the distribution are jointly and severally liable for the withheld tax; in cases of fraudulent distribution, criminal liability includes imprisonment and travel bans.
